ThingDef.Name: ROT_TradeShuttleBase
ThingDef.label: trade shuttle
ThingDef.description: A spacer-tech uranium-powered shuttle used by orbital traders to ferry goods to and from the surface during a deal. To prevent hijacking, the shuttle is locked to the pilot's bio-signature.

ThingDef.Name: ROT_ExplosiveRiggedTradeShuttleBase
ThingDef.description: A trade shuttle sent by a trader who's stopped trusting you to deal fairly. It's been openly rigged with explosives; a blunt message not to try swindling them again.

li.inspectString: This shuttle is very obviously rigged with some kind of improvised explosive device.

ThingDef.description: A trade shuttle sent while you're trying to make amends with a trader you've wronged. It arrives rigged with explosives in case you're still looking to cause trouble.
